provenance.source: Swiss Ephemeris via pyswisseph 2.10.3.2 (swe 2.10.03), SWIEPH files sepl_18.se1/semo_18.se1; run locally only to produce numbers. No Swiss Ephemeris code or data files are in this repository.
provenance.settings: calc_ut with FLG_SWIEPH|FLG_SPEED (apparent geocentric, true equinox of date, tropical); mean lunar node; houses_ex Placidus (P) or whole sign (W); Delta T = Swiss Ephemeris default.
provenance.timeZones: Local time to UTC by Python zoneinfo with tzdata 2026.6 (IANA tzdb), fold=0: ambiguous times take the earlier instant, nonexistent times use the pre-transition offset.
